title: lotoxalis frutescens
intro: Lotoxalis frutescens, commonly known as Yellow Wood Sorrel, is a perennial plant species in the Oxalidaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Lotoxalis frutescens include antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral properties, making it effective in treating various infections and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include oxalic acid, flavonoids, and anthraquinones, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
